explanation: I used WP_HTML_Tag_Processor to scan for all A opener tags via next_tag('A') (which skips tag closers by default). For each matched A tag, I called get_attribute('href') — per the docs, this returns null only when the attribute is absent, true for boolean/value-less attributes like `<a href>`, and a string (possibly empty) for `href=""` or `href="..."`. Any non-null result means href is present, so I call set_attribute('target', '_blank') which overwrites any existing target attribute. Finally, get_updated_html() returns the modified HTML string.
